paper_title: DARWIN: towards the ultimate dark matter detector
notes: DARWIN projection for galactic ALPs (axio-electric effect) improving XENON100 by ~2 orders of magnitude for 200 t*y exposure. Paper gives sensitivity curves only in Figure 4 (not tabulated); XENON100 reference limit g_Ae ~2e-12 for 1-40 keV galactic ALPs. Paper also has a solar axion projection (g_Ae^solar ~ few e-13 improving XENON100's 7.7e-12) which would be a separate curve.
